title: US: "Even in places where the Democrats haven't won, the swing towards them has been significant"
summary: Tens of millions of Americans cast their vote in the crucial polls that have been pitched as a referendum on Donald Trump's presidency amid anger at surging petrol prices, tariffs and the Iran war.
